# ngrok documentation: AI Gateway

> Every page in the AI Gateway section of the ngrok docs (129 pages). Each link points to the page's Markdown version.

## AI Gateway

- [AI Gateway Overview](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/overview.md): Control which AI models your apps can call, fail over between providers automatically, and pay with credits or your own provider keys.
- [Quickstart](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/quickstart.md): Route your application's LLM requests through ngrok.ai so you can switch models, fail over between providers, and track usage.
- [How It Works](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/how-it-works.md): Follow a request from your app through the ngrok AI Gateway to see how it's authenticated, routed to a model, and retried when a provider fails.
- [Model Catalog](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/reference/model-catalog.md): Find the built-in providers and models ngrok.ai supports, and see how the gateway matches the model names in your requests.
- [FAQ](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/faq.md): Find quick answers to common ngrok.ai questions, from setting up access keys and buying credits to troubleshooting failed requests.

## Concepts

- [Access Keys](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/concepts/access-keys.md): Access keys are separate from the provider keys that the AI Gateway stores for you. You can create, rotate, and revoke them in the dashboard or API.
- [Credits](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/concepts/credits.md): Buy ngrok.ai credits, turn on automatic top-ups, and see how requests consume credits and what happens to them when you run out.
- [Hosted Tool Billing](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/concepts/hosted-tools.md): Hosted tools bill in units like search calls or generated images, and some also add tokens. You can read each tool's rate from the List Models API.
- [Providers](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/concepts/providers.md): Learn the difference between built-in and custom providers in the ngrok AI Gateway and how the gateway picks a provider for each request.
- [Models](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/concepts/models.md): Choose and name the models in your ngrok AI Gateway requests, and list fallback models for the gateway to try next.
- [Open-Weight Models](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/concepts/open-weight-models.md): Learn what open-weight means, how open-weight models behave in the ngrok AI Gateway, and which models in the catalog are open-weight.
- [Custom Providers](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/concepts/custom-providers.md): Decide when to connect your own model server to ngrok.ai as a custom provider, and check which kinds of URLs the gateway can reach.
- [Bring Your Own Keys](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/concepts/bring-your-own-keys.md): Decide when to use your own provider API keys with ngrok.ai instead of paying with credits, then set them up for built-in or custom providers.
- [Firewall](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/concepts/firewall.md): Check what your agents send to a model and block risky tool calls before your agent runs them, with rules you attach to access keys.

## Getting Started With

- [OpenAI](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/providers/openai.md): Call OpenAI GPT models through the ngrok AI Gateway with credits or your own key, route to OpenAI explicitly, and use Files and Decisions.
- [Anthropic](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/providers/anthropic.md): Send Claude requests through ngrok.ai, pin them to Anthropic with explicit provider routing, and upload files to reuse in later requests.
- [OpenRouter](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/providers/openrouter.md): Call OpenRouter models through the ngrok AI Gateway with your own OpenRouter API key, and see how to write OpenRouter model names.
- [Google](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/providers/google.md): Call Google Gemini models through the ngrok AI Gateway with ngrok.ai credits or your own Google API key, including native Gemini requests.
- [Groq](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/providers/groq.md): Call Groq-hosted models through the ngrok AI Gateway by adding your own Groq API key to ngrok.ai and assigning it to an access key.
- [DeepSeek](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/providers/deepseek.md): Call DeepSeek models through the ngrok AI Gateway with ngrok.ai credits or your own DeepSeek API key, and check its peak and off-peak pricing.
- [xAI](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/providers/xai.md): Call xAI Grok models through the ngrok AI Gateway with ngrok.ai credits or your own xAI API key, then send your first request.
- [Mistral AI](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/providers/mistral.md): Call Mistral AI models through the ngrok AI Gateway by adding your own Mistral API key to ngrok.ai and assigning it to an access key.
- [Moonshot AI](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/providers/moonshotai.md): Call Moonshot AI Kimi models through the ngrok AI Gateway with ngrok.ai credits or your own Moonshot AI API key.
- [Z.ai](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/providers/z-ai.md): Call Z.ai GLM models through the ngrok AI Gateway with ngrok.ai credits or your own Z.ai API key, then send your first request.
- [QwenCloud](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/providers/qwencloud.md): Call QwenCloud models through the ngrok AI Gateway with ngrok.ai credits or your own QwenCloud API key, including thinking and tool calls.
- [MiniMax](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/providers/minimax.md): Call MiniMax models through the ngrok AI Gateway with ngrok.ai credits or your own MiniMax API key, then send your first request.
- [Tencent TokenHub](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/providers/tokenhub.md): Call Tencent TokenHub models through the ngrok AI Gateway with ngrok.ai credits or your own Tencent TokenHub API key.
- [Typesafe AI](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/providers/typesafeai.md): Send typed questions to Typesafe AI System One models through the ngrok AI Gateway and get back typed answers with calibrated probabilities.
- [Liquid AI](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/providers/liquid.md): Call Liquid AI's LFM chat models and d1 decision models through the ngrok AI Gateway with ngrok.ai credits or your own Liquid AI API key.
- [LLM API](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/providers/llmapi.md): Call models from many labs through LLM API in the ngrok AI Gateway, and see which you can pay for with credits and which need your own key.
- [Hyperbolic](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/providers/hyperbolic.md): Call Hyperbolic-hosted models through the ngrok AI Gateway by adding your own Hyperbolic API key to ngrok.ai and assigning it to an access key.
- [InceptionLabs](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/providers/inceptionlabs.md): Call InceptionLabs models through the ngrok AI Gateway by adding your own InceptionLabs API key to ngrok.ai and assigning it to an access key.
- [Inference.net](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/providers/inference-net.md): Call Inference.net-hosted models through the ngrok AI Gateway by adding your own Inference.net API key to ngrok.ai.
- [Ollama](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/custom-providers/ollama.md): Connect Ollama on your machine to ngrok.ai with an ngrok endpoint, so your apps can call your local models through the AI Gateway.
- [LM Studio](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/custom-providers/lm-studio.md): Connect LM Studio on your machine to ngrok.ai with an ngrok endpoint, so your apps can call your local models through the AI Gateway.
- [vLLM](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/custom-providers/vllm.md): Connect your vLLM server to ngrok.ai with an ngrok endpoint, so your apps can call your self-hosted models through the AI Gateway.
- [Azure OpenAI](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/custom-providers/azure-openai.md): Connect an Azure OpenAI deployment to the ngrok AI Gateway as a custom provider, including multiple deployments and regions.

## SDKs

- [SDK Integration](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/sdks/index.md): Learn about the official and third-party SDKs supported by ngrok.ai and how to connect each one to the AI Gateway.
- [OpenAI SDK](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/sdks/openai.md): Connect OpenAI's official SDKs to the ngrok AI Gateway so your app can call models from many providers with one access key.
- [Anthropic SDK](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/sdks/anthropic.md): Connect Anthropic's official SDKs to the ngrok AI Gateway so your Claude apps get automatic failover between models.
- [Google Gen AI SDK](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/sdks/google.md): Connect Google's Gen AI SDK to the ngrok AI Gateway with Python and TypeScript examples for GenerateContent, streaming, and stateless Interactions.
- [Vercel AI SDK](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/sdks/vercel-ai-sdk.md): Connect the Vercel AI SDK to the ngrok AI Gateway and build streaming AI apps that fail over between model providers.
- [TanStack AI](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/sdks/tanstack-ai.md): Connect TanStack AI to the ngrok AI Gateway through its OpenAI adapter and call models from your React or Solid app.
- [LangChain](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/sdks/langchain.md): Connect LangChain to the ngrok AI Gateway so your chains, RAG apps, and AI agents get automatic failover between models.
- [Other SDKs](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/sdks/other.md): Call the ngrok AI Gateway from cURL or any HTTP client or SDK that supports the OpenAI or Anthropic API format.

## Agents

- [Agents](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/agents/index.md): Route Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Hermes, and other coding agents through the ngrok AI Gateway to share model access and track usage.
- [Claude Code](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/agents/claude-code.md): Route Claude Code through the ngrok AI Gateway with two environment variables to track usage, fail over, and bill to one access key.
- [Codex](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/agents/codex.md): Add the ngrok AI Gateway as a custom model provider in the OpenAI Codex CLI to track usage and route requests with one access key.
- [Cursor](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/agents/cursor.md): Point Cursor's OpenAI base URL override at the ngrok AI Gateway to chat with catalog or self-hosted models, and learn what it doesn't cover.
- [Hermes](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/agents/hermes.md): Install the ngrok AI Gateway plugin for Hermes Agent to use your gateway's models as a Hermes model provider with one access key.
- [OpenCode](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/agents/opencode.md): Connect OpenCode to the ngrok AI Gateway to reach any model in the catalog, or a model you run yourself, with one access key.
- [Pi](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/agents/pi.md): Connect the Pi terminal coding agent to the ngrok AI Gateway to reach any model in the catalog, or a model you run yourself.
- [Zed](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/agents/zed.md): Connect the Zed editor's agent panel to the ngrok AI Gateway as an OpenAI-compatible provider to use catalog or self-hosted models.
- [Other Agents](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/agents/other.md): Connect any coding agent that accepts a custom OpenAI or Anthropic base URL to the ngrok AI Gateway with three values.

## Guides

- [Compare Models in the Playground](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/guides/playground.md): Send one prompt to up to three models in the app.ngrok.ai playground and compare their streamed answers side by side.
- [Choose How to Reach Providers](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/guides/configuring-providers.md): Compare paying with credits, bringing your own provider key, and connecting a model you run yourself, then follow the guide for your choice.
- [Pay with Credits](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/guides/pay-with-credits.md): Call OpenAI, Anthropic, and other supported models through ngrok.ai with only an access key, and learn how credits cover the model cost.
- [Bring Your Own Provider Key](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/guides/attaching-provider-keys.md): Add your own provider API key to ngrok.ai, use an access key configuration to choose which access keys can use it, and rotate it safely.
- [Use a Model You Run Yourself](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/guides/use-a-model-you-run-yourself.md): Connect Ollama, vLLM, LM Studio, or another model server on your network to ngrok.ai as a custom provider and call it with an access key.
- [Choose a Model](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/guides/model-selection-strategies.md): Compare the ways to pick a model in an AI Gateway request, whether you name the model or provider yourself or let ngrok.ai choose.
- [Automatic Model Selection](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/guides/automatic-model-selection.md): Use ngrok/auto to let ngrok.ai pick the cheapest model that can handle each prompt, and see which model answered.
- [Configure Fallback Models](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/guides/configure-fallback-models.md): List fallback models in a request so the AI Gateway can retry on another model or provider, such as a hosted backup for a private model.
- [Use Virtual Models](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/guides/virtual-models.md): Give an ordered list of models one name, so you can change the models your apps use from the gateway without changing their code.
- [Upload and Use Files](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/guides/files.md): Stop resending large documents and images with every prompt by storing them with the OpenAI or Anthropic Files API through ngrok.ai.
- [Typed-Question APIs](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/guides/decisions-and-system-one.md): Send typed questions to OpenAI Decisions and Typesafe AI System One through ngrok.ai and get back typed answers instead of chat replies.
- [Restrict Providers and Models](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/guides/restrict-providers-and-models.md): Limit an ngrok.ai access key to specific providers or models so requests for anything else fail right away, including during fallback.
- [Set Up an Access Key Configuration](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/guides/access-key-configurations.md): Create an access key configuration that controls which providers and models a key can call and which provider keys it uses.
- [Guard Agent Tool Calls with Firewall](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/guides/firewall-policies.md): Use an ngrok.ai Firewall policy to block risky AI agent tool calls, like a force-push, and test it before you enforce it.
- [Configure Provider Key Failover](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/guides/key-selection-failover.md): Add backup provider keys so the AI Gateway can retry with another key when one is rate limited or out of quota.
- [Secure Your Gateway](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/guides/securing-endpoints.md): Give each client its own access key so you can track its usage and revoke it without affecting the others. Clients never hold your provider keys.
- [Configure Account Settings](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/guides/account-settings.md): Set default timeouts, token limits, and request capture for every AI Gateway request, from the ngrok.ai dashboard or the API.
- [Handle Gateway Errors](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/guides/error-handling.md): Understand which failures the AI Gateway retries, the order it tries candidates in, and how timeouts bound the whole request.
- [Debug Failed Requests](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/guides/debugging.md): Find out why an AI Gateway request failed from its request ID, error code, and response headers, and fix the most common errors.
- [Find Out Why a Request Failed Over](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/guides/why-a-request-failed-over.md): Trace one AI Gateway request through every upstream attempt to see which providers it tried, in what order, and which one served it.

## Observability

- [Observability Overview](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/observability/index.md): Track AI Gateway usage with the Usage API, and look up any single request by its ID in app.ngrok.ai to see what happened to it.

## Examples

- [Multi-Provider Failover](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/examples/multi-provider-failover.md): These examples show how to keep your app working during a provider outage by giving ngrok.ai a list of models to try in order.
- [Multi-Key Failover](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/examples/multi-key-failover.md): This example shows how backup provider keys keep your requests working when one of your keys is rate limited or stops working.
- [Restrict Models and Providers](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/examples/model-filtering.md): These examples show how to limit which providers and models an ngrok.ai access key can call, using JSON or the dashboard.
- [Securely Put Your Self-Hosted n8n Workflows Online](https://ngrok.com/docs/gateway/examples/n8n.md): Get your n8n instance online to share with colleagues or receive webhook data with security measures designed for production usage.

## Reference

- [Error Codes Reference](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/reference/error-codes.md): Look up any ngrok AI Gateway error code to find out what it means, and learn how to handle gateway errors in your SDK code.
- [Firewall Reference](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/reference/firewall.md): Firewall policy fields and limits, the plugins request field, response headers, safeguard_results, and the errors Firewall returns.

## API Reference

- [AI Gateway API](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/api-reference/overview.md): Set up and run your AI Gateway from your own code with the management API.

## API Reference / Access Keys

- [Access Keys: List (GET /access-keys)](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/api-reference/access-keys/list.md): List all AI Gateway access keys owned by the authenticated account.
- [Access Keys: Create (POST /access-keys)](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/api-reference/access-keys/create.md): Create a new ngrok-managed access key for AI Gateway traffic.
- [Access Keys: Get (GET /access-keys/{id})](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/api-reference/access-keys/get.md): Get a single AI Gateway access key by ID.
- [Access Keys: Update (PATCH /access-keys/{id})](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/api-reference/access-keys/update.md): Update mutable fields on an existing AI Gateway access key.
- [Access Keys: Delete (DELETE /access-keys/{id})](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/api-reference/access-keys/delete.md): Delete an AI Gateway access key by ID.

## API Reference / Access Key Configurations

- [Access Key Configurations: List (GET /access-key-configurations)](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/api-reference/access-key-configurations/list.md): List all AI Gateway access key configurations owned by the authenticated account.
- [Access Key Configurations: Create (POST /access-key-configurations)](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/api-reference/access-key-configurations/create.md): Create a reusable access key configuration with provider/model scope and routing rules.
- [Access Key Configurations: Get (GET /access-key-configurations/{id})](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/api-reference/access-key-configurations/get.md): Get a single AI Gateway access key configuration by ID.
- [Access Key Configurations: Update (PATCH /access-key-configurations/{id})](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/api-reference/access-key-configurations/update.md): Apply a partial update to an AI Gateway access key configuration.
- [Access Key Configurations: Delete (DELETE /access-key-configurations/{id})](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/api-reference/access-key-configurations/delete.md): Delete an AI Gateway access key configuration by ID.

## API Reference / Firewall Policies

- [Firewall Policies: List (GET /firewall-policies)](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/api-reference/firewall-policies/list.md): List all AI Gateway Firewall policies owned by the authenticated account.
- [Firewall Policies: Create (POST /firewall-policies)](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/api-reference/firewall-policies/create.md): Create an AI Gateway Firewall policy, a named set of rules that check requests and tool calls.
- [Firewall Policies: Get (GET /firewall-policies/{id})](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/api-reference/firewall-policies/get.md): Get a single AI Gateway Firewall policy by ID.
- [Firewall Policies: Update (PATCH /firewall-policies/{id})](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/api-reference/firewall-policies/update.md): Apply a partial update to an AI Gateway Firewall policy.
- [Firewall Policies: Delete (DELETE /firewall-policies/{id})](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/api-reference/firewall-policies/delete.md): Delete an AI Gateway Firewall policy by ID.

## API Reference / Provider Keys

- [Provider Keys: List (GET /provider-keys)](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/api-reference/provider-keys/list.md): List all AI Gateway provider keys owned by the authenticated account.
- [Provider Keys: Create (POST /provider-keys)](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/api-reference/provider-keys/create.md): Create a new AI Gateway provider key for your account. Reference it from an access key configuration's routing rule steps to use it.
- [Provider Keys: Get (GET /provider-keys/{id})](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/api-reference/provider-keys/get.md): Get a single AI Gateway provider key by ID.
- [Provider Keys: Update (PATCH /provider-keys/{id})](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/api-reference/provider-keys/update.md): Update mutable fields on an existing AI Gateway provider key.
- [Provider Keys: Delete (DELETE /provider-keys/{id})](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/api-reference/provider-keys/delete.md): Delete an AI Gateway provider key by ID.
- [Provider Keys: Rotate (POST /provider-keys/{id}/rotate)](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/api-reference/provider-keys/rotate.md): Update an AI Gateway provider key by ID to a new value.

## API Reference / Providers

- [Providers: List (GET /providers)](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/api-reference/providers/list.md): List all user-defined AI Gateway providers for the authenticated account. Built-in providers come from the ngrok.ai catalog, not this resource.
- [Providers: Create (POST /providers)](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/api-reference/providers/create.md): Create a new user-defined AI Gateway provider for routing requests to a self-hosted or third-party LLM endpoint.
- [Providers: Get (GET /providers/{id})](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/api-reference/providers/get.md): Get a single AI Gateway provider by ID.
- [Providers: Update (PATCH /providers/{id})](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/api-reference/providers/update.md): Apply a partial update to an AI Gateway provider. The providerId is immutable after creation.
- [Providers: Delete (DELETE /providers/{id})](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/api-reference/providers/delete.md): Delete an AI Gateway provider and all of its models. Deletion is blocked while a provider key or access key configuration references the provider.

## API Reference / API Keys

- [API Keys: List (GET /api-keys)](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/api-reference/api-keys/list.md): List all AI Gateway API keys owned by the authenticated account.
- [API Keys: Create (POST /api-keys)](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/api-reference/api-keys/create.md): Create a new AI Gateway API key for the authenticated account.
- [API Keys: Get (GET /api-keys/{id})](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/api-reference/api-keys/get.md): Get a single AI Gateway API key by ID.
- [API Keys: Update (PATCH /api-keys/{id})](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/api-reference/api-keys/update.md): Update mutable fields on an existing AI Gateway API key.
- [API Keys: Delete (DELETE /api-keys/{id})](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/api-reference/api-keys/delete.md): Delete an AI Gateway API key by ID.

## API Reference / Credits

- [Credits: Balance (GET /credits/balance)](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/api-reference/credits/balance.md): Get the account's current AI Gateway credit balance. Eventually consistent with usage events.
- [Credits: Transactions (GET /credits/transactions)](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/api-reference/credits/transactions.md): Returns a merged, date-descending list of credit purchases and metered usage invoices for the account. Read from the billing provider in real time.
- [Credits: Checkout session (POST /credits/checkout-session)](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/api-reference/credits/checkout-session.md): Create a Stripe-hosted checkout session to purchase AI Gateway credits.
- [Credits: Purchase create (POST /credits/purchases)](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/api-reference/credits/purchase-create.md): Start an off-session charge of the account's saved card to buy AI Gateway credits, then poll the purchase for its terminal outcome.
- [Credits: Purchase get (GET /credits/purchases/{id})](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/api-reference/credits/purchase-get.md): Get one credit purchase attempt by ID to poll it to a terminal state and read the decline reason recorded on failure.

## API Reference / Models

- [Models: List (GET /v1/models)](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/api-reference/models/list.md): List every model available to your account, including built-in catalog models and your own user-defined provider models.

## API Reference / Virtual Models

- [Virtual Models: List (GET /virtual-models)](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/api-reference/virtual-models/list.md): List the virtual models in your account, with any warnings about targets or names that changed after the last save.
- [Virtual Models: Create (POST /virtual-models)](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/api-reference/virtual-models/create.md): Create a virtual model, a name that clients send as the model and that stands for an ordered list of models to try in turn.
- [Virtual Models: Get (GET /virtual-models/{id})](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/api-reference/virtual-models/get.md): Get one virtual model by ID, including its models in failover order and any warnings.
- [Virtual Models: Update (PATCH /virtual-models/{id})](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/api-reference/virtual-models/update.md): Rename a virtual model, replace its list of models, or change its description. New requests use the change with no client update.
- [Virtual Models: Delete (DELETE /virtual-models/{id})](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/api-reference/virtual-models/delete.md): Delete a virtual model. Clients that still send its name get an unknown model error.

## API Reference / Configuration

- [Configuration: Get (GET /gateway-config)](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/api-reference/gateway-config/get.md): Get the AI Gateway configuration for the authenticated account.
- [Configuration: Update (PATCH /gateway-config)](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/api-reference/gateway-config/update.md): Update the AI Gateway configuration for the authenticated account. Omitted fields preserve their existing stored value.

## API Reference / Usage

- [Usage: List (GET /usage)](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/api-reference/usage/list.md): List per-attempt AI Gateway usage events for the authenticated account.
- [Usage: Overview (GET /usage/overview)](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/api-reference/usage/overview.md): Aggregated daily cost, request, and error series for the authenticated account over a time window, grouped by provider or access key.
- [Usage: Request attempts (GET /usage/requests/{requestId})](https://ngrok.com/docs/ai-gateway/api-reference/usage/request-attempts.md): Get every upstream attempt the AI Gateway made for one client request, ordered by attempt number.
